title: psephellus leucophyllus
intro: Psephellus leucophyllus, commonly known as the mountain daisy or mountain hawk's beard, is a flowering plant species belonging to the sunflower family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Psephellus leucophyllus include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
